notes.title: Major Update! Demo 2.0 is Now Out!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Over the last few months, our development team has been hard at work creating version 2.0 of the "Distant Oceanic Getaway" demo! We're so excited to show you the results, and we can't wait to hear your feedback!

Here's a list of all the updates we've made:
[olist]
[*] New romanceable character— Aimé
[*] New interactive segments: Chat, date, and touch added
[*] New personality traits: Stone top, pillow princess, demisexual, and edgy
[*] New Camille and Aimé voiceovers
[*] 8 new CGs!
[*] Updated the Day 3 Night event
[*] Improved the "photo album" feature
[*] Added the "voucher" system. Welcome drink vouchers can now be redeemed on dates!
[*] Updated some background and art assets
[*] Added new BGM
[*] Fixed a few typos
[/olist]

Want sneak peeks? Progress updates? Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/u9mnfUfgvh/


Or follow us on Twitter: https://x.com/DistantOceanic/

Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/redbeantaiyaki.bsky.social/


The next major update of "Distant Oceanic Getaway" will be the official release of the game. See you in 2025!

notes.title: Game Demo Update v1.0.5
notes.notes:
Game Demo Update v1.0.5

New Features:
• Added new event for Lyn
• Introduced "Turn off Live 2D" option

Improvements:
• Enhanced Day to Day animation
• Changed some background music
• Added new dialogues
• Modified Day 2 Morning Event logic

Bug Fixes:
• Corrected various typos
• Fixed minor bugs

We hope you enjoy these updates! Your feedback is valuable to us as we continue to improve the game.

notes.title: "Distant Oceanic Getaway" has officially launched on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]"Distant Oceanic Getaway" has officially launched on Steam![/b][/h1]

Exciting news! After over 6 months of being in development, the official demo for "Distant Oceanic Getaway" is now officially available to download on Steam! 
A full playthrough of the demo that explored all available routes will take approximately five hours.
